note: Single-differential, flux-integrated νμ CC 1π+ (resonance-region, W_exp < 1.4 GeV/c²) production cross sections on MINERvA scintillator, measured vs seven kinematic variables: pion kinetic energy T_π, pion angle θ_π, muon momentum p_μ, muon longitudinal momentum p_μ,z, muon transverse momentum p_μ,T, muon angle θ_μ, and Q². Michel-electron ("untracked") pion reconstruction extends T_π acceptance down to 0 (no threshold) for the first time. NuMI Medium-Energy on-axis beam, MINERvA detector, νμ mode. Target: per nucleon (CH scintillator target, ~3.47×10^30 target nucleons; source: main.tex table captions "in units of 10^-42 cm²/X/nucleon" and main text "normalizing by the integrated neutrino flux (0-100 GeV) and the number of target nucleons (~3.47×10^30)").
